title: Farm Real Estate Loans — Tax and Insurance Servicing Terms by Product
content:
Four terms protect the mortgaged land and buildings of a Farm Real Estate Loans mortgage:

- **Protective advance fee** — the fee per protective advance made to pay delinquent property taxes, in USD.
- **Tax cure period** — the calendar days after a county delinquency date by which the member must show the tax paid before a protective advance is made.
- **Buildings insurance threshold** — the appraised value of insurable buildings above which hazard insurance with the association as mortgagee is required, in USD.
- **Flood notice period** — the calendar days after the flood-insurance notice before flood insurance is force-placed on buildings in a special flood hazard area.

| Product | Protective advance fee (USD) | Tax cure period (calendar days) | Hazard insurance required when insurable buildings exceed (USD) | Flood notice period (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| FarmLand Variable-Rate Mortgage | 100 | 30 | 50000 | 45 |
| FarmLand 3-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 100 | 30 | 50000 | 45 |
| FarmLand 5-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 100 | 30 | 50000 | 45 |
| FarmLand 10-Year Adjustable Mortgage | 100 | 30 | 50000 | 45 |
| FarmLand 15-Year Fixed Mortgage | 100 | 30 | 50000 | 45 |
| FarmLand 25-Year Fixed Mortgage | 100 | 30 | 50000 | 45 |

**Reading the terms.** The four figures are the same on every FarmLand product. The buildings threshold is a strict "above": insurable buildings appraised at exactly USD 50000 do not meet it, while buildings appraised at USD 50000.01 or more do.
